title: Placement
description: Which workloads run on which node, and how full each node is.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Requests are what the scheduler has reserved, and what decides whether the next pod fits; used is the host's real CPU busy time and memory over the last five minutes, page cache excluded. A cordoned node keeps its pods but takes no new ones.

targets.expr: max by (node, role) (kube_node_role{node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true", node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable{node=~"$node"})

count by (node) ((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node", node!=""}))
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

max by (node) (label_replace(100 * (1 - sum by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}) / count by (nodename) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

max by (node) (label_replace(100 * (1 - sum by (nodename) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}) / sum by (nodename) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * on (instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
max by (node, os_image, kernel_version) (kube_node_info{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Workloads on $node
panels.description: Running and pending pods grouped by what owns them. A Deployment's ReplicaSets are folded into the Deployment, CronJob runs into the CronJob; a Cluster is a CloudNativePG Postgres. Requests are what the scheduler reserved on the node; used is the last five minutes. Most pods here are pinned with a nodeSelector (see the root README, "Storage"), which no metric exposes: this shows where pods run, not where they are allowed to.

targets.expr: count by (namespace, kind, workload, node) ((max by (namespace, pod, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)-[a-z0-9]+"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="Job", owner_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[0-9]+"), "kind", "CronJob", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "kind", "Pod", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_kind, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>", owner_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node="$node", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)))

1000 * sum by (namespace, kind, workload, node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kind, workload, node) (max by (namespace, pod, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)-[a-z0-9]+"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="Job", owner_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[0-9]+"), "kind", "CronJob", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "kind", "Pod", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_kind, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>", owner_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node="$node", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)))

1000 * sum by (namespace, kind, workload, node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kind, workload, node) (max by (namespace, pod, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)-[a-z0-9]+"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="Job", owner_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[0-9]+"), "kind", "CronJob", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "kind", "Pod", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_kind, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>", owner_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node="$node", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)))

sum by (namespace, kind, workload, node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kind, workload, node) (max by (namespace, pod, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)-[a-z0-9]+"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="Job", owner_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[0-9]+"), "kind", "CronJob", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "kind", "Pod", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_kind, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>", owner_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node="$node", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)))

sum by (namespace, kind, workload, node) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kind, workload, node) (max by (namespace, pod, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)-[a-z0-9]+"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="Job", owner_name=~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[0-9]+"), "kind", "CronJob", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="<none>", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "kind", "Pod", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, owner_kind, owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{owner_kind!~"ReplicaSet|<none>", owner_name!~".+-[0-9]{8,}", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node="$node", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)))

panels.title: Pods per node
panels.description: Running and pending pods on each node. A step down on one node and up on the other is pods moving.

targets.expr: count by (node) ((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node", node!=""}))

panels.title: Memory requested per node
panels.description: Requests against allocatable (dashed). Requested reaching allocatable is when a node stops taking pods.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", node=~"$node", node!=""} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))
max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

1000 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", node=~"$node", node!=""} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))
1000 * max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})
